description: My landlord in Davao City refuses to return my security deposit after I moved out. Lease says return within 30 days. I left the unit clean and have photos.
I worked for a construction firm in Davao for 3 months without receiving salary. I have timesheets and chat messages from my supervisor promising pay.
I paid for shoes online through Facebook Marketplace in Davao but the seller blocked me after I sent 2500 pesos via GCash. I have screenshots of the chat and receipt.
My neighbor in Davao City drives a modified car with a very loud muffler revving past our house at 2 AM almost every night. Barangay asked them to stop but they continue.
I got top merits on the job evaluation then my employer in Davao terminated me two days later without written notice or just cause. I have the merit certificate and termination letter.
My neighbor's chicken keeps entering my garden in Davao and laying eggs in my vegetable plot. I asked them to fence it but they refuse. I want to know my legal options.
